component.name: EcpTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "serve" end sub
sub serve() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("command", port) m.host = "" pending = m.top.command if pending <> invalid and pending.kind <> invalid then handle(pending) while true msg = wait(0, port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then handle(msg.getData()) end while end sub
sub handle(cmd as Object) if cmd = invalid or cmd.kind = invalid then return if cmd.kind = "apps" then listApps() else if cmd.kind = "launch" then launch(cmd.id) end if end sub
' The loopback address first, then the TV's own network address. function hosts() as Object list = ["127.0.0.1"] ips = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo").GetIPAddrs() for each name in ips list.Push(ips[name]) end for return list end function
function request(url as String, post as Boolean) as Object ut = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") p = CreateObject("roMessagePort") ut.SetMessagePort(p) ut.SetUrl(url) ut.RetainBodyOnError(true) if post then started = ut.AsyncPostFromString("") else started = ut.AsyncGetToString() end if if not started then return { code: -1, body: "" } msg = wait(4000, p) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" then return { code: msg.GetResponseCode(), body: msg.GetString() } ut.AsyncCancel() return { code: 0, body: "" } end function
sub listApps() tried = [] for each host in hosts() r = request("http://" + host + ":8060/query/apps", false) tried.Push(host + " " + r.code.ToStr()) if r.code = 200 then apps = [] xml = CreateObject("roXMLElement") if xml.Parse(r.body) then for each node in xml.GetChildElements() attrs = node.GetAttributes() kind = attrs["type"] appId = attrs["id"] if kind = invalid then kind = "" if appId = invalid then appId = "" if node.GetName() = "app" and (kind = "appl" or kind = "tvin") and appId <> "" and appId <> "dev" then apps.Push({ id: appId, name: node.GetText(), kind: kind }) end if end for end if m.host = host m.top.result = { kind: "apps", ok: true, host: host, apps: apps, detail: tried.Join(", ") } return end if end for m.top.result = { kind: "apps", ok: false, host: "", apps: [], detail: tried.Join(", ") } end sub
sub launch(id as String) tried = [] order = hosts() if m.host <> "" then order.Unshift(m.host) for each host in order r = request("http://" + host + ":8060/launch/" + id, true) tried.Push(host + " " + r.code.ToStr()) if r.code >= 200 and r.code < 300 then m.top.result = { kind: "launch", ok: true, id: id, detail: tried.Join(", ") } return end if end for m.top.result = { kind: "launch", ok: false, id: id, detail: tried.Join(", ") } end sub
